CYTOGENETICS LABORATORY REPORT
[redacted location] Regional Genetics Laboratory

Patient: [redacted name]
DOB: [redacted date]
MRN: [redacted ID]
Specimen ID: [redacted ID]
Referring Clinician: Dr. [redacted name]
Date Collected: [redacted date]
Date Reported: [redacted date]

TEST PERFORMED
Karyotype Analysis - G-banded Chromosome Study

CLINICAL INDICATION
Rule out Down syndrome and chromosomal abnormalities

PREVIOUS TESTING
Rapid aneuploidy PCR performed (see separate report)

METHODOLOGY
Peripheral blood lymphocytes were cultured and harvested according to standard protocols. G-banded metaphase chromosomes were analyzed at 400-550 band resolution. A minimum of 20 cells were counted and 5 cells were fully analyzed.

RESULT
46,XX
Normal female karyotype

No evidence of trisomy 21 or other numerical abnormalities detected.
No major structural chromosomal rearrangements identified.

LIMITATIONS
This analysis is adequate to exclude numerical abnormalities and major structural rearrangements. Small deletions, duplications, or subtle rearrangements below the resolution of conventional cytogenetics cannot be excluded.

INTERPRETATION
Normal female karyotype. Down syndrome and other common chromosomal aneuploidies excluded.

ADDITIONAL TESTING
Molecular testing for spinal muscular atrophy has been requested separately through the DNA laboratory (see separate report when available).

Authorized by: [redacted name], PhD, FACMG
Clinical Cytogeneticist
